paragraphs: This is the brand index for ScentDealsDaily. Each name opens that house: the bottles we price-checked at Perfumania, FragranceShop, or FragranceNet, with the size and the compare-at price that retailer listed. A brand page also explains how the house tends to smell, which famous bottles people ask for, and which checked bottle fits a gift. We do not fill in a discount, a stock status, or a star rating that is not part of that check.

The houses run from fresh daytime colognes to sweet gift perfumes and a few higher-priced bottles. If you already know the brand, open it. If you are shopping by person instead of by logo, the holiday gift guides group checked bottles for him, for her, and for specific recipients. Men's colognes, women's perfumes, and unisex bottles have their own lists, and the roundups below group bottles we already checked by style.

A brand page only shows a price for a bottle in its grid. Other well-known fragrances are named so you can tell whether the bottle on sale is the one you meant: Terre d'Hermès versus H24, CK One versus Eternity, Eros versus Bright Crystal. Side-by-side comparisons and scent roundups are linked from a brand page only when that page's bottles are already on them. The date under the heading is the check behind the numbers in the grid.

intro: Hermès is the French leather house, and the perfumes are cut in the same spirit: tailored, sheer, and rarely sweet. A lot of designer fragrance leans on vanilla, sugar, or a loud fruit. Hermès more often smells of citrus, herbs, flowers treated like fabric, and dry woods. Shoppers who want a caramel gourmand are usually in the wrong aisle. Shoppers who want a polished daytime scent, or a citrus that does not smell like a body spray, are in the right one.

The men's cologne people ask for by name is Terre d'Hermès, a citrus with pepper and wood. The Jardin series is lighter and greener, each one built around a garden rather than a locker-room fresh accord. On the women's side, Twilly is the ginger floral and Eau des Merveilles is the salty orange-amber. Those are the names to know before you decide whether the bottle in the grid is the Hermès you meant.

known.name: H24
known.text: The Hermès cologne with a checked price on this page. It is aromatic and woody: clary sage, narcissus, and rosewood, with a dry edge rather than a sweet base. Choose it when you want a modern Hermès office scent and you are not trying to buy Terre d'Hermès.

known.name: Terre d'Hermès
known.text: The bottle most people mean by a Hermès cologne for men. Citrus opening, a peppery spice, and a woody drydown. It is the classic gift in this house. This page does not price it, so do not treat H24 as the same purchase.

known.name: Jardin collection
known.text: Un Jardin en Méditerranée, Un Jardin sur le Nil, and the other Jardins are green, watery garden scents. They are lighter than Terre d'Hermès and easier in hot weather. They are not sweet gifts, and they are not in today's grid.

known.name: Twilly d'Hermès and Eau des Merveilles
known.text: Twilly is a ginger floral, brighter and more playful than most Hermès. Eau des Merveilles is orange, amber, and salty woods, a common women's Hermès gift for someone who already likes the house. Neither has a checked price here.

choose: For a Hermès cologne gift, ask which name they actually wear. Terre d'Hermès is the famous answer, and it is a different scent from H24, the bottle we checked. Give H24 to someone who likes fresh, slightly serious cologne and does not want vanilla on their skin. Skip it for a recipient who wants something sweet, fruity, or heavy for evening.

For a woman, Twilly is the easier Hermès to explain to someone new to the house. Eau des Merveilles fits a person who already likes woody or amber perfume. A Jardin is the pick for someone who wants light and green. Only H24's size and retailer price are on this page. Any other Hermès name is context, not a deal we verified.

faqs.q: Is H24 the same as Terre d'Hermès?
faqs.a: They are different colognes from the same house. Terre d'Hermès is the citrus, pepper, and wood scent people already know. H24 is a later aromatic woody fragrance, drier and more modern, with sage and rosewood. Sharing a brand does not make them substitutes.

faqs.q: Are Hermès perfumes sweet?
faqs.a: The house style is citrus, herbs, gardens, and woods. Twilly is prettier and spicier than Terre d'Hermès, and Eau des Merveilles has a warm amber side. Hermès is still the wrong house when the gift needs to smell like vanilla, caramel, or a sugary fruit.

faqs.q: Which Hermès should I gift if I have not smelled it?
faqs.a: H24 is the bottle with a checked price here, and it suits someone who already wears fresh or woody cologne. If they asked for Terre d'Hermès by name, H24 is a different scent. Use the description above before you treat the two as the same gift.

faqs.q: Does this page list every Hermès fragrance?
faqs.a: It lists the Hermès bottles we price-checked. Terre d'Hermès, the Jardins, Twilly, and Eau des Merveilles are named so you can see they are separate scents from the bottle in the grid. They do not get a price on this page.

intro: Montblanc is known first for pens and leather goods. The fragrance line follows that brief: polished, wearable, and aimed at everyday life rather than a loud night out. The men's scents are the ones shoppers recognize. They tend to smell clean, woody, and a little fruity, the sort of cologne you can wear to an office without announcing it from the elevator.

Legend is the men's cologne the house is known for, a smooth crowd-pleaser. Explorer is the other widely asked-for men's bottle, fresher and woodier, often shopped by people who want something a bit more outdoors than Legend. Women's Montblanc bottles, including Signature, sit in softer florals. The page you are on is about the bottle we actually checked, which is a Legend flanker, not the whole catalog.

known.name: Legend Spirit
known.text: The Montblanc bottle with a checked price here. It is the lighter, fresher take on Legend: grapefruit and bergamot up top, pink pepper, lavender, and white woods. Give it when you want Legend's easy style without a heavier base.

known.name: Legend
known.text: The original men's Montblanc cologne and the name most gift shoppers mean. It is a polished, fruity-woody everyday scent, smoother and a bit fuller than Legend Spirit. This page does not price the original.

known.name: Explorer
known.text: The other famous men's Montblanc. People look for it when they want a fresh woody cologne in the same general family as modern woody aromatics. It is a different bottle from Legend Spirit, and it is not in today's grid.

known.name: Montblanc for women
known.text: Signature and the other women's Montblancs are softer florals, a separate shopping trip from the Legend line. Nothing in that group has a checked price on this page.

choose: Legend Spirit is the right Montblanc gift when the person likes fresh citrus and clean woods, and when a heavier evening cologne would be too much. It is a flanker, so someone who specifically wants the original Legend is asking for a different scent. Explorer is the name to look for if they described a woodier, more outdoors cologne.

It is a comfortable men's gift for a dad, a partner, or a coworker who wears cologne to work. It is a weak match for someone who wants sweet vanilla, a club scent, or a women's floral. The only Montblanc price on this page is the Legend Spirit bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Legend Spirit the same as Montblanc Legend?
faqs.a: Legend Spirit is a fresher flanker of Legend, with grapefruit, bergamot, lavender, and white woods. The original Legend is the smoother, better-known men's cologne. They share a name and a house style. They are not the same bottle.

faqs.q: What does Montblanc cologne usually smell like?
faqs.a: The men's line people know, Legend and Explorer, is clean, fresh, and woody, built for daytime. Montblanc is not a house of heavy sweet or smoky scents. Women's bottles move toward softer florals.

faqs.q: Is Legend Spirit a safe cologne gift?
faqs.a: It is a safe gift for someone who likes fresh, office-friendly cologne. It is a poor match if they asked for the original Legend by name, or if they want a sweet vanilla cologne. The checked bottle is the one in the grid above.

faqs.q: Do you price Explorer or the original Legend?
faqs.a: This page prices the Montblanc bottles in the deal grid. Right now that is Legend Spirit. Explorer and the original Legend are described so you can tell them apart, and they are not given a price here.

intro: Coach is the American leather house, and the fragrances are built to be easy. They are the bottles you buy when the person likes a recognizable brand and a pleasant everyday smell, not a niche composition. Women's Coach scents are mostly fruity florals. The men's cologne is fresh, a little fruity, and woody in the drydown, with a light leather idea rather than a heavy leather jacket.

The names shoppers search are Coach for women, the Coach Dreams flankers, and Coach for Men. Dreams and the women's original are sweeter and more floral. Coach for Men is the fresh daytime cologne. This page checks a men's bottle only, so a search for a Coach perfume for her is a different product from the one in the grid.

known.name: Coach for Men
known.text: The Coach bottle with a checked price on this page. It opens fresh and fruity, pear and bergamot with a bright citrus, and dries down woody with cardamom, amberwood, and vetiver. It is a daily men's cologne, not a sweet night scent.

known.name: Coach for women
known.text: The signature women's perfume is a fruity floral, brighter and sweeter than the men's cologne. It is the bottle most people mean by a Coach perfume gift. This page does not price it.

known.name: Coach Dreams
known.text: A popular women's flanker in the same easy, fruity-floral family. People who already like the original Coach often look here next. It is not the men's cologne in the grid, and it has no checked price here.

known.name: Coach Floral and the other flankers
known.text: The women's line keeps adding lighter floral versions of the same idea. They are still separate from Coach for Men. Use the men's cologne above only when the gift is for someone who wears cologne, not perfume.

choose: Coach for Men is a straightforward gift for someone who likes fresh, slightly fruity cologne and a woody drydown. It fits daytime, work, and a recipient who does not want a heavy sweet scent. The leather in the brand story shows up as a light woody accent, so do not buy it for someone who asked for a smoky leather perfume.

If the gift is for her, the name to look for is Coach or Coach Dreams, which are women's fruity florals. Those are not the bottle we checked. The only Coach price on this page is the men's eau de toilette in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Coach cologne the same as Coach perfume?
faqs.a: Coach for Men is a fresh, fruity, woody cologne. The women's Coach perfumes are fruity florals, sweeter and brighter. The bottle on this page is the men's cologne. A Coach perfume gift for her is a different product.

faqs.q: What does Coach for Men smell like?
faqs.a: The bottle we track opens with pear, bergamot, and citrus, then cardamom, amberwood, and vetiver. It reads as a fresh daytime cologne with a woody finish. It is not a heavy leather scent and it is not a vanilla gourmand.

faqs.q: Who is Coach for Men a good gift for?
faqs.a: Someone who wants an easy men's cologne for work or daytime, and who likes fresh fruit more than sweet spice. Skip it for a recipient who wants a women's floral or a loud evening scent.

faqs.q: Do you have Coach Dreams or the women's perfume?
faqs.a: This page only prices Coach bottles we checked. The grid is the men's cologne. Coach Dreams and the women's Coach perfumes are named so you can tell them apart, and they are not priced here.

intro: Tom Ford fragrances sit at the expensive end of designer perfume. The house is known for statement scents: dark florals, leather, woods, tobacco, and a few bright colognes. The Private Blend line is where the higher prices and the bolder compositions live. The signature line is slightly more daily, though still not a drugstore bottle. People shop Tom Ford when the gift should feel special, and when a sweet mainstream perfume would seem too ordinary.

The names that come up in almost every Tom Ford conversation are Black Orchid, Oud Wood, Tobacco Vanille, Lost Cherry, Neroli Portofino, and Café Rose. They do not smell like one another. Black Orchid is a dark floral. Oud Wood is dry wood. Tobacco Vanille is tobacco and vanilla. Lost Cherry is a dessert cherry. Neroli Portofino is a bright citrus cologne. Café Rose is a rose with coffee. Matching the name to the person matters more here than it does at a brand with one famous cologne.

known.name: Café Rose
known.text: The Tom Ford bottle with a checked price on this page. It is a rose perfume with coffee, patchouli, cardamom, and frankincense, from the Private Blend line. It suits someone who likes rose and also wants something warm and a little bitter, not a soft pretty rose.

known.name: Black Orchid
known.text: The dark floral people picture first. Rich, spicy, and unmistakable, worn as a statement rather than a quiet office scent. It is a different purchase from Café Rose, and this page does not price it.

known.name: Oud Wood and Tobacco Vanille
known.text: Oud Wood is a dry, spicy wood scent and a common men's or shared gift. Tobacco Vanille is warm tobacco and vanilla, sweeter and heavier. Both are famous Private Blend names. Neither is the rose in the grid.

known.name: Lost Cherry and Neroli Portofino
known.text: Lost Cherry is the sweet cherry gourmand. Neroli Portofino is the bright citrus cologne, the fresh end of the house. They show how wide Tom Ford runs. This page prices Café Rose only.

choose: Café Rose is the Tom Ford gift when the person likes rose and would enjoy coffee and spice in the same perfume. It is a poor match for someone who wants a clean citrus, a fresh men's cologne, or a simple sweet vanilla. It is also the wrong bottle if they named Black Orchid, Oud Wood, or Tobacco Vanille. Those are separate Private Blend scents.

Because Tom Ford prices sit high even on sale, buy the name they actually wear. A Private Blend bottle is a generous gift and an easy one to get wrong. The only checked price on this page is Café Rose in the grid. The other names are here so you can see what you are not buying.

faqs.q: What does Tom Ford Café Rose smell like?
faqs.a: Rose, with coffee, patchouli, cardamom, and frankincense. It is a warm rose, not a light watery one, and not a plain sweet perfume. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Café Rose the same as Black Orchid?
faqs.a: They are different Private Blend perfumes. Black Orchid is the dark, spicy floral the house is famous for. Café Rose is a rose-and-coffee scent. Buying one does not give you the other.

faqs.q: Which Tom Ford is the usual men's gift?
faqs.a: Oud Wood and Tobacco Vanille are the men's or shared names people ask for most often. Neroli Portofino is the fresh citrus. Café Rose, the bottle priced here, is a rose perfume and a better gift for someone who likes rose.

faqs.q: Why is there only one Tom Ford bottle on this page?
faqs.a: We only show a Tom Ford fragrance when we have checked a price at an authorized retailer. Café Rose is that bottle today. The other famous names are explained so they are not confused with it, and they are not given a price here.

intro: Xerjoff is an Italian niche house. The bottles are ornate, the prices sit well above typical designer cologne, and the range is wide: bright citrus, rich honey and tobacco, and loud fruity musks. People who know the brand usually name a specific scent. People who only know the logo are easy to mismatch, because Naxos, Erba Pura, and a Casamorati citrus do not smell like variations of one idea.

Casamorati is the classical, Italian-style line inside Xerjoff. Mefisto is the fresh men's scent in that line. Naxos is the famous Xerjoff, a honeyed lavender and tobacco that many shoppers mean when they say they want a Xerjoff. Erba Pura is the fruity musk, sweeter and louder. The bottle we checked is Mefisto, which is the fresh end of the house.

known.name: Casamorati Mefisto
known.text: The Xerjoff bottle with a checked price on this page. It is a citrus aromatic: grapefruit, bergamot, and lemon, with lavender and iris, drying down toward sandalwood, cedar, and amber. It wears like a polished fresh cologne, not like a sweet niche extrait.

known.name: Naxos
known.text: The Xerjoff people ask for most often. Honey, lavender, and tobacco, warm and full. It is a different gift from Mefisto. This page does not price it.

known.name: Erba Pura
known.text: A fruity musk, brighter and sweeter than the rest of the famous lineup. Shoppers who want a juicy niche scent look here. It is not the citrus in the grid.

known.name: The Casamorati line
known.text: Casamorati is Xerjoff's classical group, separate from Naxos and Erba Pura. Mefisto is one men's cologne inside it. Other Casamorati names are their own scents, and they are not priced here.

choose: Mefisto is the Xerjoff gift for someone who likes fresh citrus cologne and wants the bottle to feel more expensive than a standard designer fresh scent. Lavender and woods keep it from smelling like lemonade. It is the wrong gift if they said Naxos, which is honey and tobacco, or Erba Pura, which is sweet and fruity.

Niche prices make the name important. If you are unsure which Xerjoff they meant, Mefisto is only a safe bet for a fresh-cologne wearer. The only checked Xerjoff price on this page is the Mefisto bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Xerjoff Mefisto smell like?
faqs.a: A citrus aromatic: grapefruit, bergamot, lemon, lavender, and iris, with sandalwood, cedar, and amber underneath. It is a fresh men's cologne from the Casamorati line, not a sweet tobacco scent.

faqs.q: Is Mefisto the same as Xerjoff Naxos?
faqs.a: Naxos is the honey, lavender, and tobacco scent people usually mean by a Xerjoff. Mefisto is a bright citrus aromatic in the Casamorati line. They share a house and little else.

faqs.q: Is Mefisto a good gift if they have never worn Xerjoff?
faqs.a: It can be, if they already like fresh citrus colognes and you want a step up from a basic designer bottle. It is a weak first Xerjoff for someone who wants sweet, fruity, or tobacco. Erba Pura and Naxos are the names those shoppers mean.

faqs.q: Why is Xerjoff on a deals page with designer brands?
faqs.a: We list it when an authorized retailer has a checked price. Mefisto is that bottle. Other Xerjoff names are described so they are not confused with it, and they are not given a price here.

intro: Clinique is a skincare brand, and the fragrances follow that clean reputation. They are bright, fresh, and easier to wear in an office than a heavy evening perfume. Happy is the one almost everyone has smelled: a citrus floral that smells cheerful rather than sultry. Aromatics Elixir is the other classic, an herbal chypre that is much more serious and old-school.

The Happy line has a women's perfume, lighter flankers, and a men's version. Happy for Men is a fresh citrus, still in the same upbeat family. Aromatics Elixir is the bottle to know if the person likes herbs, moss, and a vintage style. This page checks the women's Happy, which is the citrus floral.

known.name: Happy
known.text: The Clinique bottle with a checked price on this page. It is a citrus floral: grapefruit, orange, mandarin, and apple, with lily of the valley, freesia, and rose. It is a daytime perfume, bright and easy, not a sweet night scent.

known.name: Aromatics Elixir
known.text: The other famous Clinique. Herbal, mossy, and chypre, with a serious character Happy does not have. People who love it are loyal. It is a different gift from Happy, and this page does not price it.

known.name: Happy Heart and other Happy flankers
known.text: Lighter or fruitier versions of the same cheerful idea. They are still Happy, not Aromatics Elixir. They are not the bottle in the grid unless the grid says so.

known.name: Happy for Men
known.text: A fresh citrus in the Happy family, sold as a men's cologne. It is closer to Happy than to a woody men's cologne. This page prices the women's Happy.

choose: Happy is a good Clinique gift for someone who likes bright citrus florals, daytime perfume, and a scent that stays friendly rather than sweet or smoky. It works for a mother, a friend, or a coworker who does not want a heavy bottle. It is a poor match for someone who loves vanilla gourmands or who already wears Aromatics Elixir and wants that herbal chypre.

If they said Clinique and did not say which one, Happy is the name most people mean. Confirm that before you buy, because Aromatics Elixir smells nothing like it. The only Clinique price on this page is the Happy bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Clinique Happy smell like?
faqs.a: A bright citrus floral: grapefruit, orange, mandarin, apple, lily of the valley, freesia, and rose. It is a daytime perfume. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Happy the same as Aromatics Elixir?
faqs.a: Happy is a citrus floral. Aromatics Elixir is an herbal chypre, much drier and more old-fashioned. They are both Clinique, and they are not interchangeable gifts.

faqs.q: Is Clinique Happy only for women?
faqs.a: The bottle on this page is the women's Happy. Clinique also sells Happy for Men, a fresh citrus in the same cheerful family. This page prices the women's perfume.

faqs.q: Who should skip Clinique Happy?
faqs.a: Someone who wants a sweet vanilla, a woody men's cologne, or the herbal smell of Aromatics Elixir. Happy is for a person who likes bright citrus and soft flowers.

intro: Paco Rabanne fragrances are built as big, recognizable designer scents. The men's side is split between two ideas people already know: 1 Million, which is sweet, warm, and a little leathery, and Invictus, which is fresh, sporty, and aquatic. The women's side has Lady Million, a sweet floral, and Olympéa, a salty vanilla. They are all loud enough that the name matters.

Newer bottles such as Phantom sit next to Invictus, and Fame sits on the women's side. You do not need the whole tree to shop a gift. You need to know whether the person wants sweet, fresh, or floral. The bottle we checked is Olympéa, the salty-vanilla women's perfume.

known.name: Olympéa
known.text: The Paco Rabanne bottle with a checked price on this page. It is a salty vanilla: water jasmine and mandarin over vanilla, a salt accord, and sandalwood. Sweeter than a fresh floral, less candied than a plain cupcake perfume, with that saline edge the line is known for.

known.name: 1 Million
known.text: The sweet men's cologne in the gold bar bottle. Warm, amber, and a little leathery. It is the men's gift people mean when they say a sweet Paco Rabanne. This page does not price it.

known.name: Invictus
known.text: The fresh, sporty men's cologne. Aquatic and easier for daytime than 1 Million. A different request from Olympéa, and not in today's grid.

known.name: Lady Million
known.text: The sweet women's floral, brighter and more candy-like than Olympéa. Shoppers who want a fun, sweet Paco Rabanne perfume often mean this one. It is not the salty vanilla in the grid.

choose: Olympéa is the Paco Rabanne gift for someone who likes vanilla and jasmine and does not mind a salty, beach-adjacent edge. It fits a partner or a friend who wears sweet perfume and wants something more distinctive than a plain floral. It is the wrong bottle if they asked for 1 Million or Invictus, which are men's colognes, or for Lady Million, which is a sweeter floral.
For a man, the famous split is 1 Million when they want sweet and Invictus when they want fresh and sporty. Those are not priced here. The only Paco Rabanne price on this page is Olympéa in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Paco Rabanne Olympéa smell like?
faqs.a: Salty vanilla: water jasmine, mandarin, vanilla, a salt accord, and sandalwood. It is a sweet women's perfume with a saline edge. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Olympéa the same as Lady Million?
faqs.a: Lady Million is the sweeter, brighter women's floral. Olympéa is vanilla with a salty jasmine character. Both are Paco Rabanne perfumes for women, and they are not the same scent.

faqs.q: Which Paco Rabanne cologne should I buy for a man?
faqs.a: 1 Million is the sweet, warm men's scent. Invictus is the fresh sporty one. This page does not price either. The checked bottle here is Olympéa, a women's perfume.

faqs.q: Is Olympéa a safe sweet perfume gift?
faqs.a: It is a good gift for someone who already likes vanilla and can handle a salty note. It is a weak gift for someone who wants a shy floral, a fresh citrus, or a men's cologne.

intro: Bvlgari is the Italian jewelry house. The fragrances are polished and a little drier than the sweetest designer lines. Men's Bvlgari Man bottles are woody. Aqva is the aquatic. The women's Omnia line is warm rather than a light office floral. Nothing in the house is trying to be a candy perfume, which is useful when the recipient finds most gifts too sweet.

Man Wood Neroli is a specific men's cologne in the Man line: wood, as the name says, with neroli and orange blossom. Man in Black is the darker, spicier men's Bvlgari. The original Man is the more straightforward woody one. This page checks Man Wood Neroli only.

known.name: Man Wood Neroli
known.text: The Bvlgari bottle with a checked price on this page. Citrus and wood: neroli, bergamot, and orange blossom over cedar, amber, and a light leather. It is a fresh woody cologne, not a sweet amber bomb.

known.name: Bvlgari Man
known.text: The woody men's line the Man Wood Neroli bottle belongs to. The original Man is the broader woody cologne people mean by the name. Wood Neroli is the citrus-and-wood version. This page prices Wood Neroli.

known.name: Man in Black
known.text: The darker, spicier men's Bvlgari. People look for it when they want evening and weight. It is a different gift from the fresher Wood Neroli, and it is not priced here.

known.name: Aqva and Omnia
known.text: Aqva is the aquatic men's Bvlgari. Omnia is the warm women's line, spiced rather than a sheer floral. Both are well known and neither is the bottle in the grid.

choose: Man Wood Neroli is the Bvlgari gift for a man who likes citrus and woods together, and who would find a sweet vanilla cologne too heavy. Neroli and orange blossom keep it fresh. Cedar and amber keep it from smelling like a plain sport spray. It is a strong daytime and office gift.

Skip it if they asked for Man in Black, which is the darker spicy one, or for Aqva, which is marine. For a woman, Omnia is the Bvlgari name to look for, and it is not priced on this page. The only checked Bvlgari price here is Man Wood Neroli.

faqs.q: What does Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli smell like?
faqs.a: Neroli, bergamot, and orange blossom over cedar, amber, and a light leather. Fresh citrus on a woody base. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Man Wood Neroli the same as Bvlgari Man in Black?
faqs.a: Man in Black is the darker, spicier men's Bvlgari. Man Wood Neroli is fresher, with neroli and wood. They are different colognes in the same men's line.

faqs.q: Is there a Bvlgari perfume for women on this page?
faqs.a: The checked bottle is Man Wood Neroli, a men's cologne. Omnia is the women's line people usually mean, and it is not priced here.

faqs.q: Who is Man Wood Neroli a good gift for?
faqs.a: A man who likes fresh citrus and woods, including for work. It is a poor match for someone who wants a sweet vanilla, a marine Aqva, or a women's floral.

intro: Jean Paul Gaultier fragrances are playful on purpose. The bottles are costumes, and the smells are just as direct. Le Male, in the sailor torso, is the men's classic: mint and vanilla, sweet and fresh at the same time. Classique is the women's vanilla and orange blossom in the corset bottle. Scandal is the sweeter women's perfume people buy when they want something louder. Ultra Male pushes Le Male further into sweet territory.

Le Beau is the tropical one. Coconut and tonka, still clearly Gaultier, less minty than Le Male. That is the bottle we checked. If someone says they want the original JPG men's cologne, they almost always mean Le Male, not Le Beau.

known.name: Le Beau
known.text: The Jean Paul Gaultier bottle with a checked price on this page. Coconut and tonka, with bergamot. A sweet, tropical men's cologne, sunnier than Le Male and less minty.

known.name: Le Male
known.text: The sailor-bottle classic: mint and vanilla. It is the JPG men's cologne people mean by default. Ultra Male is the sweeter flanker. This page does not price either.

known.name: Classique
known.text: The women's vanilla and orange blossom in the corset bottle. A sweet floral gift, separate from the men's colognes. Not priced here.

known.name: Scandal
known.text: The louder, sweeter women's JPG. Shoppers who want a flirtier perfume than Classique often land here. It is not Le Beau, and it has no checked price on this page.

choose: Le Beau is the Jean Paul Gaultier gift for a man who likes coconut, tonka, and a vacation-in-a-bottle sweetness. It works for a partner or a younger relative who already wears sweet cologne. It is the wrong bottle if they asked for Le Male, because Le Male is mint and vanilla and smells familiar to anyone who grew up around it.
For a woman, Classique is the vanilla-orange-blossom classic and Scandal is the sweeter modern one. Neither is in the grid. The only Jean Paul Gaultier price on this page is Le Beau.

faqs.q: What does Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau smell like?
faqs.a: Coconut and tonka, with bergamot. Sweet and tropical. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Le Beau the same as Le Male?
faqs.a: Le Male is mint and vanilla, the sailor-bottle classic. Le Beau is coconut and tonka. Both are men's Jean Paul Gaultier colognes, and they are easy to tell apart once you know the flavors.

faqs.q: Which Jean Paul Gaultier should I gift a man?
faqs.a: Le Male if they want the famous mint-vanilla cologne. Le Beau, the bottle priced here, if they want coconut and sweetness. Ultra Male if they want Le Male turned sweeter. Only Le Beau has a checked price on this page.

faqs.q: What about a Jean Paul Gaultier perfume for women?
faqs.a: Classique is the vanilla and orange blossom. Scandal is the sweeter women's perfume. This page prices Le Beau, a men's cologne, and does not price the women's bottles.

intro: Elizabeth Arden has a long fragrance counter, and two names still do most of the work. Green Tea is the light one: citrus and tea, the bottle people wear to work and in warm weather because it stays fresh and does not fill a room. Red Door is the classic floral, richer and more dressed up. Sunflowers is the cheerful daytime floral, easier and brighter than Red Door.

The Green Tea line has many flankers. The one to start with is the original green-tea scent, which is what we checked. 5th Avenue is another women's Arden, a softer floral, and it is a third path if neither tea nor Red Door sounds right. This page is for shoppers comparing those ideas, with a price only on Green Tea.

known.name: Green Tea
known.text: The Elizabeth Arden bottle with a checked price on this page. Citrus and tea: lemon, bergamot, rhubarb, green tea, a little jasmine, and oakmoss. Light, fresh, and built for daytime.

known.name: Red Door
known.text: The classic Elizabeth Arden floral, richer and spicier than Green Tea. It is the dressier gift. This page does not price it.

known.name: Sunflowers
known.text: A bright, cheerful daytime floral. Lighter in mood than Red Door and sweeter than Green Tea. A common Arden gift when tea is too austere. Not priced here.

known.name: Green Tea flankers
known.text: The Green Tea name covers a lot of limited versions. The bottle in the grid is the original citrus-tea scent. A flanker with a fruit or flower in the name is a different product.

choose: Green Tea is the Elizabeth Arden gift for someone who likes light, fresh perfume and dislikes heavy sweetness. It suits warm weather, offices, and a recipient who says most perfume gives them a headache. It is a weak match for someone who wants a romantic floral or a vanilla night scent. Those shoppers are closer to Red Door or Sunflowers.

If they already own a Green Tea flanker, check the name on the bottle before you assume the original is what they want. The only Elizabeth Arden price on this page is the Green Tea bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Elizabeth Arden Green Tea smell like?
faqs.a: Lemon, bergamot, rhubarb, green tea, jasmine, and oakmoss. A light citrus-tea perfume for daytime. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Green Tea the same as Red Door?
faqs.a: Green Tea is a fresh citrus-tea scent. Red Door is the classic, richer floral. They are both Elizabeth Arden, and they suit different people.

faqs.q: Is Green Tea a good office perfume?
faqs.a: It is one of the lighter mainstream perfumes, which is why people wear it to work and in the daytime. It is a poor choice when the gift is supposed to be a heavy evening scent.

faqs.q: Do you price Red Door or Sunflowers?
faqs.a: This page prices the Elizabeth Arden bottle in the grid, which is Green Tea. Red Door and Sunflowers are described so you can tell them from Green Tea, and they are not given a price here.

intro: Ralph Lauren fragrances follow the clothes: preppy, American, and split between a few clear ideas. Polo, the green bottle, is the men's classic, piney and spicy, and it still defines the brand for a lot of fathers and grandfathers. Polo Blue is the fresh aquatic update. On the women's side, Romance is the soft floral and Ralph is the brighter fruity one. Big Pony bottles are the casual, colorful set.
A Ralph Lauren gift goes wrong when those names get swapped. Polo is not Romance. Polo Blue is not the green Polo. The bottle we checked is Romance, the women's floral.

known.name: Romance
known.text: The Ralph Lauren bottle with a checked price on this page. A soft floral built around rose, worn as a classic feminine perfume rather than a sweet gourmand. It is the women's gift in this house.

known.name: Polo
known.text: The green-bottle men's cologne. Pine, spice, and a classic barbershop weight. It is what many people mean by Ralph Lauren cologne. This page does not price it.

known.name: Polo Blue
known.text: The fresh aquatic men's Ralph Lauren. Cleaner and more modern than the green Polo. A different request, and not in the grid.

known.name: Ralph
known.text: The brighter, fruity women's perfume. Younger and less rose-like than Romance. Named so a Romance gift is not confused with it. Not priced here.

choose: Romance is the Ralph Lauren gift for someone who likes a classic rose floral and does not want a sugary perfume. It fits a partner, a mother, or a relative who wears polished, traditional florals. It is the wrong bottle for a man. A men's Ralph Lauren gift is Polo if they want the green classic, or Polo Blue if they want fresh and aquatic.

Ralph, the women's fruity one, is the alternative when Romance's rose would feel too traditional. None of the men's bottles, and not Ralph, have a checked price here. The only Ralph Lauren price on this page is Romance.

faqs.q: What does Ralph Lauren Romance smell like?
faqs.a: A soft floral centered on rose. It is a classic women's perfume, not a sweet gourmand and not a men's cologne. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Romance the same as Polo?
faqs.a: Polo is the green-bottle men's cologne, piney and spicy. Romance is a women's rose floral. They share a brand and nothing you would notice in the air.

faqs.q: Which Ralph Lauren cologne should I buy for a man?
faqs.a: Polo for the classic green bottle. Polo Blue for a fresh aquatic. This page does not price either. The checked bottle here is Romance, a women's perfume.

faqs.q: Is Romance a good gift for someone who likes sweet perfume?
faqs.a: Romance is a rose floral, softer and less sugary than a gourmand. If they want fruit and sweetness, the Ralph women's perfume is the closer name, and it is not priced on this page.

intro: Lancôme is one of the big French perfume houses, and La Vie Est Belle is the bottle that took over the counter. It is a sweet iris gourmand: pear and flowers up top, praline and vanilla underneath. People who like dessert-leaning perfume often mean that one when they say Lancôme. The older names are still worth knowing. Trésor is the rose classic. Poême is a fuller floral with mimosa and vanilla. Idôle is the cleaner modern floral.

Those four cover most gift questions. La Vie Est Belle if they want sweet. Poême or Trésor if they want a fuller, more traditional floral. Idôle if they want something lighter and newer. This page checks two of them: La Vie Est Belle and Poême.

known.name: La Vie Est Belle
known.text: A Lancôme bottle with a checked price on this page. Floral gourmand: pear, iris, jasmine, and orange blossom over praline, vanilla, and tonka. The sweet Lancôme people already know.

known.name: Poême
known.text: The other Lancôme bottle with a checked price here. A fuller floral oriental: mimosa, jasmine, and tuberose with vanilla and tonka. Richer and more classic than La Vie Est Belle, less of a dessert.

known.name: Trésor
known.text: The rose Lancôme, a classic women's perfume that predates La Vie Est Belle. Softer and more traditionally floral than the gourmand. This page does not price it.

known.name: Idôle
known.text: The modern Lancôme floral, cleaner and less sweet than La Vie Est Belle. The name to look for when they want a current Lancôme that is not a praline perfume. Not priced here.

choose: Choose La Vie Est Belle when the person likes sweet perfume, iris, and a praline dryness under the sugar. It is one of the easier famous gifts because so many people already know the smell. Choose Poême when they like a fuller, more traditional floral and would find La Vie Est Belle too dessert-like. Mimosa, jasmine, and tuberose make Poême the dressier, older-style Lancôme.

Trésor is the rose to look for if neither of those fits, and Idôle is the lighter modern one. This page prices La Vie Est Belle and Poême only. A side-by-side with Valentino Donna Born in Roma is linked below when you are choosing between two sweet florals.

faqs.q: What does La Vie Est Belle smell like?
faqs.a: Pear, iris, jasmine, and orange blossom, with praline, vanilla, and tonka. A sweet floral gourmand. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: How is Poême different from La Vie Est Belle?
faqs.a: Poême is a fuller floral: mimosa, jasmine, tuberose, vanilla, and tonka. La Vie Est Belle is sweeter and more gourmand, with pear, iris, and praline. Both are priced on this page. They are not the same perfume.

faqs.q: Is Trésor the same as La Vie Est Belle?
faqs.a: Trésor is the classic rose Lancôme. La Vie Est Belle is the sweet iris-and-praline perfume. People who grew up with Trésor are not automatically asking for La Vie Est Belle.

faqs.q: Which Lancôme is the safer gift?
faqs.a: La Vie Est Belle is the safer famous gift for someone who likes sweet perfume. Poême is the better gift for someone who likes a rich floral and finds dessert perfumes too sweet. The grid has the checked prices for both.

intro: Giorgio Armani fragrances split into a few families people already shop by name. Acqua di Gio is the fresh men's cologne: citrus and a marine note, the bottle that defined a whole style of daytime cologne. Code is the sweeter, more evening men's Armani. On the women's side, Sì is the well-known floral. Stronger With You is the warm, sweet men's line, and Intensely is the richer flanker, with toffee and spice rather than sea air.

Acqua di Gio and Stronger With You Intensely are both on this page, which is useful, because they answer opposite gift questions. One is fresh. One is sweet. Buying the wrong one is the usual Armani mistake.

known.name: Acqua di Gio
known.text: A Giorgio Armani bottle with a checked price on this page. Aquatic and citrus: lime, bergamot, and neroli with marine notes and white musk. The fresh men's Armani.

known.name: Stronger With You Intensely
known.text: The other Armani bottle with a checked price here. Toffee and spice: toffee, cinnamon, lavender, vanilla, and tonka. Sweet, warm, and meant for cooler weather or evening, not for a beach day.

known.name: Acqua di Gio Profumo and Profondo
known.text: Deeper flankers of Acqua di Gio. People who already wear the original sometimes want these instead. They are not the eau de toilette in the grid, and they are not priced here.

known.name: Code and Sì
known.text: Code is the sweeter evening men's Armani, separate from both Acqua di Gio and Stronger With You. Sì is the women's floral. Named so a men's gift does not get swapped for them. Not priced on this page.

choose: Give Acqua di Gio to someone who likes fresh citrus cologne, warm weather, and a scent that stays clean. It is the default Armani men's gift when you know nothing else, and it is a poor match for a person who finds fresh colognes boring. Give Stronger With You Intensely to someone who likes sweet, spicy, vanilla-leaning cologne. Toffee and cinnamon make it a cold-weather and date-night bottle.

Do not cross them. A fan of Acqua di Gio is not asking for Stronger With You, and the reverse is just as true. Code is the other evening name, and Sì is the women's perfume. This page prices Acqua di Gio and Stronger With You Intensely. Comparisons with Versace Pour Homme, Montblanc Legend Spirit, Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense, and Azzaro The Most Wanted are linked below.

faqs.q: What does Acqua di Gio smell like?
faqs.a: Lime, bergamot, neroli, marine notes, and white musk. A fresh aquatic men's cologne. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Stronger With You Intensely smell like?
faqs.a: Toffee, cinnamon, lavender, vanilla, and tonka. Sweet and warm, unlike Acqua di Gio. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Which Armani should I gift a man?
faqs.a: Acqua di Gio if he likes fresh citrus cologne. Stronger With You Intensely if he likes sweet spice and vanilla. Code is the other evening name, and it is not priced here. Both checked bottles are on this page.

faqs.q: Is there a Giorgio Armani perfume for women in the grid?
faqs.a: The bottles with checked prices here are men's: Acqua di Gio and Stronger With You Intensely. Sì is the women's Armani people usually mean, and it is not priced on this page.

intro: Juicy Couture perfume is playful on purpose. The brand's fragrance reputation is bright, sweet, and casual, the opposite of a stern French floral. Viva La Juicy is the flagship: a fruity floral people buy when they want something fun and recognizable. Peace, Love and Juicy Couture sits in that same family, fruity and floral, a little more specific in the flowers and the fruit.

These are not office-formal perfumes and they are not woody niche scents. They are gifts for someone who likes sweetness, fruit, and a youthful style. The bottle we checked is Peace, Love and Juicy Couture.

known.name: Peace, Love and Juicy Couture
known.text: The Juicy Couture bottle with a checked price on this page. A fruity floral: hyacinth, cassis, red apple, honeysuckle, jasmine, and musk. Sweet and bright, in the same playful lane as the rest of the line.

known.name: Viva La Juicy
known.text: The flagship Juicy Couture perfume, a sweet fruity floral and the name most shoppers mean. Peace, Love is a relative, not a rename. This page does not price Viva La Juicy.

known.name: Viva La Juicy flankers
known.text: Gold Couture, Noir, and the other Viva La Juicy versions shift the sweetness and the flowers. They are still not Peace, Love. None of them are priced here.

known.name: What this house is not
known.text: Juicy Couture is a weak search if you want a fresh citrus cologne, a rose soliflore, or a serious evening chypre. The line is sweet, fruity, and casual.

choose: Peace, Love and Juicy Couture is a gift for someone who likes fruity florals: apple, cassis, honeysuckle, and jasmine, finished with musk. It fits a friend, a sister, or a teen who wants a fun perfume rather than a formal one. It is a poor match for a recipient who wears woody perfume or who finds sweet scents too much.

If they asked for Viva La Juicy by name, Peace, Love is the same brand and a similar mood, and it is still a different perfume. The only Juicy Couture price on this page is the Peace, Love bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Peace, Love and Juicy Couture smell like?
faqs.a: A fruity floral: hyacinth, cassis, red apple, honeysuckle, jasmine, and musk. Bright and sweet. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Peace, Love the same as Viva La Juicy?
faqs.a: Viva La Juicy is the flagship sweet fruity floral. Peace, Love and Juicy Couture is a related fruity floral with apple, cassis, and honeysuckle. Same house style, different perfume. This page prices Peace, Love.

faqs.q: Who is this a good gift for?
faqs.a: Someone who likes sweet, fruity, casual perfume. A friend or a younger relative is a better match than someone who wants a classic rose or a fresh cologne.

faqs.q: Do you price Viva La Juicy?
faqs.a: The Juicy Couture bottle with a checked price here is Peace, Love and Juicy Couture. Viva La Juicy is described so the two are not treated as the same product, and it is not given a price on this page.

intro: Billie Eilish perfume is a small line with a clear split. The original Eilish is a warm vanilla gourmand: sugar, berries, cacao, and tonka, the bottle people mean when they say it smells like vanilla. Eilish No. 2 is the follow-up, and it is not a sweeter version of the first. It is woody and floral, with bergamot, apple blossom, pepper, palo santo, and a quieter vanilla.
That split is the whole shopping decision. Sweet vanilla, or drier wood. Both bottles have a checked price on this page, which makes the comparison practical instead of theoretical.

known.name: Eilish
known.text: A Billie Eilish bottle with a checked price on this page. Vanilla gourmand: sugar, red berries, vanilla, cacao, and tonka. Warm and sweet. This is the original.

known.name: Eilish No. 2
known.text: The other Billie Eilish bottle with a checked price here. Woody floral: bergamot, apple blossom, black pepper, papyrus, palo santo, ebony, and vanilla. Less sugary than the original, with the wood doing more of the work.

known.name: How the two get confused
known.text: The bottles look related and the name is the same house. The smells are the gift decision. Original Eilish is dessert vanilla. No. 2 is wood, pepper, and a lighter vanilla.

known.name: Who the line is for
known.text: Both are women's perfumes with a young, recognizable audience. They are popular friend and sister gifts. They are an odd match for someone who wants a classic aldehyde floral or a fresh men's cologne.

choose: Give the original Eilish to someone who likes vanilla, cocoa, and a warm sweet perfume. Give Eilish No. 2 to someone who likes Billie Eilish and does not want a sugar perfume, or who prefers wood, pepper, and palo santo. If you do not know which they meant, ask. The names are close and the scents are not.

No. 2 is the better daytime pick of the two when sweetness is the worry. The original is the better gift when they have said they want something cozy and vanilla. Both prices are in the grid. A side-by-side of the two is linked below.

faqs.q: What does the original Billie Eilish perfume smell like?
faqs.a: Sugar, red berries, vanilla, cacao, and tonka. A warm vanilla gourmand. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Eilish No. 2 smell like?
faqs.a: Bergamot, apple blossom, black pepper, papyrus, palo santo, ebony, and vanilla. Woody and floral, with less sugar than the original. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Which Billie Eilish perfume should I gift?
faqs.a: The original if they want vanilla and sweetness. No. 2 if they want wood and spice and a quieter vanilla. Both have a checked price on this page.

faqs.q: Are Eilish and Eilish No. 2 the same formula?
faqs.a: They are different perfumes. The original is a vanilla gourmand. No. 2 is a woody floral. The shared name is the brand, not the scent.

intro: Valentino's current fragrance reputation sits on Born in Roma. Donna Born in Roma is the women's perfume: jasmine and bourbon vanilla, a sweet floral that became a default gift. Uomo Born in Roma is the men's line, and it comes in more than one concentration. The eau de toilette is fresher and mineral. The Intense is sweeter, with vanilla and lavender. Voce Viva is the other women's Valentino people still ask about, a separate floral from Donna.
All three Born in Roma bottles that shoppers mix up are on this page: Donna, Uomo, and Uomo Intense. The gift gets easy once you sort women versus men, and fresh versus sweet.

known.name: Donna Born in Roma
known.text: A Valentino bottle with a checked price on this page. Jasmine and bourbon vanilla, with black currant and cashmeran. A sweet floral, the women's Born in Roma.

known.name: Uomo Born in Roma
known.text: A Valentino bottle with a checked price here. Mineral and fresh: a salt accord, violet leaf, ginger, sage, and vetiver. The lighter men's Born in Roma, not the Intense.

known.name: Uomo Born in Roma Intense
known.text: The third Valentino bottle with a checked price on this page. Vanilla, lavender, and vetiver. Sweeter and denser than the eau de toilette, a cold-weather men's scent.

known.name: Voce Viva
known.text: Another women's Valentino, floral and separate from Donna Born in Roma. Named so a Donna gift is a deliberate choice. This page does not price it.

choose: Donna Born in Roma is the women's gift when they like jasmine and vanilla together. It is in the same shopping conversation as other sweet florals, including Lancôme La Vie Est Belle, and it is still its own perfume. Uomo Born in Roma eau de toilette is the men's gift when they like fresh, slightly mineral cologne. Uomo Intense is the men's gift when they like vanilla and want the sweeter Born in Roma.

The usual mistake is buying Intense for someone who wears the fresh Uomo, or buying Uomo for someone who wanted Donna. Read the gender and the word Intense before you use the grid. Voce Viva is the other women's name, and it is not priced here.

faqs.q: What does Valentino Donna Born in Roma smell like?
faqs.a: Black currant, jasmine, bourbon vanilla, and cashmeran. A sweet floral. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Uomo Born in Roma and Intense?
faqs.a: The eau de toilette is mineral and fresh: salt, violet leaf, ginger, sage, and vetiver. Intense is vanilla, lavender, and vetiver, sweeter and heavier. Both are priced on this page.

faqs.q: Which Valentino should I gift?
faqs.a: Donna Born in Roma for a woman who likes jasmine and vanilla. Uomo eau de toilette for a man who likes fresh cologne. Uomo Intense for a man who likes sweet vanilla. All three have checked prices in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Voce Viva the same as Donna Born in Roma?
faqs.a: Voce Viva is a separate women's Valentino floral. Donna Born in Roma is the jasmine-and-vanilla Born in Roma perfume. This page prices Donna, Uomo, and Uomo Intense.

intro: Azzaro's men's lineup has three lanes shoppers still buy. The original is a lavender aromatic, a classic rather than a sweet modern cologne. Chrome is the fresh citrus, and Chrome Legend is the greener flanker. The Wanted line is the sweet one: The Most Wanted is spiced vanilla, and Wanted Night is the evening eau de parfum. This page checks four of those bottles.

known.name: Chrome Legend
known.text: An Azzaro bottle with a checked price on this page. A green fresh cologne: green apple, tea, bitter orange, and vetiver. Lighter and greener than the Wanted bottles.

known.name: Azzaro Pour Homme
known.text: The original, listed in the grid as Azzaro Cologne. An aromatic men's classic, lavender with a warm spicy drydown. It is not Chrome and it is not a sweet vanilla.

known.name: The Most Wanted
known.text: An Azzaro bottle with a checked price here. Spiced vanilla: ginger, woods, and bourbon vanilla. The sweet modern Azzaro, built for someone who likes warm gourmand cologne.

known.name: Wanted Night
known.text: The evening Wanted, listed in the grid as Wanted. An eau de parfum, warmer and spicier than a fresh Chrome. Shoppers looking for Wanted by Night are looking at this bottle.

choose: Chrome Legend for a fresh green daytime cologne. The original Azzaro for a classic lavender aromatic. The Most Wanted for ginger and bourbon vanilla. Wanted Night for the warmer evening Wanted. The original Chrome citrus is a different flanker from Chrome Legend and is not in the grid.
Those four grid bottles are the only Azzaro prices on this page. The Most Wanted sits next to Versace Eros Flame and Armani Stronger With You Intensely in the comparisons below.

faqs.q: What does Azzaro Chrome Legend smell like?
faqs.a: Green apple, tea, bitter orange, and vetiver. A fresh green cologne. The checked bottle is in the grid. It is a Chrome flanker, not The Most Wanted.

faqs.q: What does Azzaro The Most Wanted smell like?
faqs.a: Ginger, woods, and bourbon vanilla. Sweet and warm. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Which Azzaro should I gift?
faqs.a: Chrome Legend for fresh and green. The original Azzaro Cologne for a classic lavender aromatic. The Most Wanted for spiced vanilla. Wanted Night for a warmer evening Wanted. All four have checked prices on this page.

faqs.q: Is Wanted Night the same as The Most Wanted?
faqs.a: The Most Wanted is the spiced bourbon-vanilla parfum. Wanted Night is the evening eau de parfum in the Wanted line, listed here as Wanted. Both are sweet modern Azzaros, and they are different bottles.

intro: Burberry fragrances are wearable British designer scents, usually fresher or softer than the sweetest mainstream lines. Weekend is the casual men's citrus. Hero is the woody men's cologne for daily wear. London for women is a white floral. Touch for women is a softer floral, and Touch for men is a separate fresh cologne. Her and Mr. Burberry are the other names shoppers add when they already know the house. The grid is the bottles we checked.

known.name: Weekend
known.text: A Burberry bottle with a checked price on this page. Citrus cologne: lemon, grapefruit, mandarin, and melon, on a honey-musk base. Light and casual.

known.name: Hero
known.text: A Burberry bottle with a checked price here. A woody men's cologne for everyday wear, fuller than Weekend and less sweet than most evening colognes.

known.name: London
known.text: A Burberry bottle with a checked price here. A women's white floral: honeysuckle, tangerine, rose, jasmine, peony, and sandalwood. Warmer than a sheer citrus perfume.

known.name: Touch
known.text: A Burberry bottle with a checked price here. A softer women's floral, lighter in mood than London. Use it when they want Burberry and do not want a big white-floral bouquet.

known.name: Touch for Men
known.text: A Burberry bottle with a checked price here. A fresh men's cologne, not the women's Touch floral. Artemisia, violet leaf, mandarin, nutmeg, and white musk.

choose: Weekend is the men's gift for fresh citrus and an easy daytime cologne. Hero is the men's gift when they want wood and something a bit more dressed than Weekend. London is the women's gift for a white floral with rose and jasmine. Touch is the women's gift when London would be too much flower.

Her is the fruity-floral women's Burberry many people mean, and Mr. Burberry is the aromatic men's one. Neither is in this grid. Match Weekend versus Hero, and London versus women's Touch, before you buy. Men's Touch is a different cologne from the women's floral, and it is in the grid when we have checked a price.

faqs.q: What does Burberry Weekend smell like?
faqs.a: Lemon, grapefruit, mandarin, and melon, with a honey-musk base. A light men's citrus. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Burberry London for women smell like?
faqs.a: Honeysuckle, tangerine, rose, jasmine, peony, and sandalwood. A white floral. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Weekend or Hero for a man?
faqs.a: Weekend if he likes fresh citrus. Hero if he likes a woody everyday cologne. Both have checked prices on this page.

faqs.q: London or Touch for a woman?
faqs.a: London for a fuller white floral. Touch for a softer, lighter floral. Both are priced in the grid. Men's Touch is a separate cologne, also priced when it is in the grid. Her, the fruity-floral Burberry, is a different perfume and is not priced here.

intro: Calvin Klein made its fragrance name on clean, shareable scents. CK One is the citrus aromatic worn by anyone. Eternity is the women's green floral, and Eternity Air is the lighter flanker. Eternity for men is a separate cologne. Obsession is the spicy classic and Euphoria is the sweeter one. A name is in the grid only when that bottle has a checked price.

known.name: CK One
known.text: Citrus aromatic for anyone: lemon, bergamot, pineapple, green tea, and musk. The shared fresh Calvin Klein.

known.name: CK Everyone
known.text: A watery unisex: orange, ginger, tea, and cedar. Clean like CK One, with more tea and less sharp citrus.

known.name: Eternity
known.text: Women's green floral: freesia, mandarin, sage, lily, rose, and sandalwood. The classic floral gift.

known.name: Eternity Air
known.text: The lighter Eternity: grapefruit, black currant, peony, pear, and musk. The daytime pick.

known.name: Free
known.text: Aromatic woody men's cologne: juniper, star anise, coffee, cedar, oak, and patchouli.

known.name: Beauty
known.text: Soft floral musk: ambrette, jasmine, and cedar. Quieter than Eternity.

known.name: Eternity for Men
known.text: A separate cologne from the women's Eternity floral. Lavender, mandarin, coriander, lily, and sandalwood. It is in the grid when we have checked a price.

known.name: Obsession
known.text: The spicy women's classic: mandarin, peach, basil, and vanilla. Not the fresh citrus of CK One, and not Eternity.

known.name: Euphoria
known.text: The sweeter Calvin Klein floral: pomegranate, orchid, and amber. A night-leaning perfume, not the daytime Eternity.

choose: CK One when the gift should be fresh citrus for anyone. CK Everyone when you want that clean idea with tea instead of sharp citrus. Eternity for a women's floral with lily and rose. Eternity Air when they want grapefruit and peony. Free for a woody men's cologne. Beauty for a quiet jasmine musk.

Obsession is the spicy musk classic. Euphoria is the sweeter floral. Men's Eternity is not the women's floral. One versus Everyone, the two women's Eternitys, and Eternity Air versus Green Tea are linked below. The grid is every Calvin Klein bottle with a checked price.

faqs.q: Is CK One for men or women?
faqs.a: CK One is a citrus aromatic sold for anyone: lemon, bergamot, pineapple, green tea, and musk. CK Everyone is the later watery unisex. Both are priced on this page.

faqs.q: Eternity or Eternity Air?
faqs.a: Eternity is the green floral with freesia, lily, rose, and sandalwood. Eternity Air is fresher: grapefruit, black currant, peony, and pear. Air is the daytime pick. Both have checked prices here.

faqs.q: What does Calvin Klein Free smell like?
faqs.a: Juniper, star anise, coffee, Virginia cedar, oak, and patchouli. An aromatic woody men's cologne, not a sweet vanilla. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: What do Obsession and Euphoria smell like?
faqs.a: Obsession is the spicy musk classic, with mandarin, peach, and vanilla. Euphoria is sweeter, with pomegranate, orchid, and amber. Checked bottles of either one are in the grid. They are not CK One or Eternity.

intro: Hugo Boss colognes are built for regular wear. Bottled is the men's scent the house is known for, a polished apple-and-spice cologne. Bottled Unlimited is the fresher one. Boss In Motion is spicier and woodier. Bottled No. 6 is the eau de parfum in that Bottled family, richer than the Unlimited eau de toilette. Boss Woman is a fruity floral, separate from the men's bottles. All four of those checked bottles are on this page.

known.name: Bottled Unlimited
known.text: A Hugo Boss bottle with a checked price on this page. A fresh fougère: mint, grapefruit, violet leaf, pineapple, and sandalwood. The daytime Bottled.

known.name: Boss In Motion
known.text: A Hugo Boss bottle with a checked price here. Spicy woody: orange, cardamom, cinnamon, sandalwood, and vetiver. Warmer than Unlimited.

known.name: Bottled No. 6
known.text: A Hugo Boss bottle with a checked price here. An eau de parfum in the Bottled line, fuller than the fresh Unlimited eau de toilette.

known.name: Boss Woman
known.text: A Hugo Boss bottle with a checked price here. Fruity floral: mango, mandarin, violet root, freesia, and sandalwood. The women's bottle on this page.

choose: Bottled Unlimited is the men's gift for fresh mint and grapefruit. Boss In Motion is the men's gift for orange, cardamom, and woods. Bottled No. 6 is the pick when they want the Bottled line in a richer eau de parfum. Boss Woman is the gift for someone who likes mango and a soft floral, not a men's cologne.

The original Bottled, apple and spice, is the famous one and is not the same as Unlimited or No. 6. The only Hugo Boss prices on this page are the four bottles in the grid. Unlimited and In Motion are compared side by side below.

faqs.q: What does Boss Bottled Unlimited smell like?
faqs.a: Mint, grapefruit, violet leaf, pineapple, and sandalwood. A fresh men's cologne. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Unlimited or Boss In Motion?
faqs.a: Unlimited is the fresh fougère. In Motion is orange, cardamom, cinnamon, sandalwood, and vetiver, spicier and woodier. Both are priced on this page.

faqs.q: Is Bottled No. 6 the same as Bottled Unlimited?
faqs.a: No. 6 is the eau de parfum in the Bottled line. Unlimited is the fresh eau de toilette. Both are in the grid. The original apple-and-spice Bottled is a third scent and is not priced here.

faqs.q: Is there a Hugo Boss perfume for women here?
faqs.a: Boss Woman is the women's bottle with a checked price: mango, mandarin, freesia, and sandalwood. The other three grid bottles are men's colognes.

intro: Versace fragrances are bright and easy to recognize. Eros is the men's bestseller, mint and vanilla together. Eros Flame is the spicier flanker. Pour Homme is the cleaner citrus. Dylan Blue Pour Femme and Bright Crystal Absolu are the women's fruity florals in the grid. Men's Dylan Blue and the original Bright Crystal are the related names that are not.

known.name: Eros
known.text: A Versace bottle with a checked price on this page. Sweet fresh cologne: mint, green apple, tonka, ambroxan, and vanilla. The men's Versace most people mean.

known.name: Eros Flame
known.text: A Versace bottle with a checked price here. Spicy sweet: lemon, black pepper, rose, tonka, and vanilla. Warmer than Eros, still in the same family.

known.name: Pour Homme
known.text: A Versace bottle with a checked price here. Citrus aromatic: lemon, bergamot, neroli, clary sage, and amber. The fresh Versace, without Eros's mint-vanilla sweetness.

known.name: Dylan Blue Pour Femme
known.text: A Versace bottle with a checked price here. Fruity floral: green apple, black currant, peach, rose, jasmine, and musk.

known.name: Bright Crystal Absolu
known.text: A Versace bottle with a checked price here. Fruity floral: yuzu, raspberry, peony, lotus, magnolia, and amber. Richer than the original Bright Crystal, which is the lighter one people often mean.

choose: Eros for mint, apple, and vanilla. Eros Flame for that sweetness with pepper. Pour Homme for citrus without the mint-vanilla. Dylan Blue Pour Femme for apple, peach, and rose. Bright Crystal Absolu for a fuller fruity floral than the original Bright Crystal.

Men's Dylan Blue is a fresh aromatic and is not the women's bottle in the grid. The five bottles above are the only Versace prices on this page. Eros versus Flame, and the two women's florals, are compared below.

faqs.q: What does Versace Eros smell like?
faqs.a: Mint, green apple, tonka, ambroxan, and vanilla. Fresh and sweet. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Eros or Eros Flame?
faqs.a: Eros is mint and apple with vanilla. Flame adds lemon, black pepper, rose, and a warmer tonka-vanilla. Flame is the evening-leaning one. Both are priced here.

faqs.q: What is Versace Pour Homme for?
faqs.a: A citrus aromatic: lemon, bergamot, neroli, and clary sage. Choose it over Eros when the gift should be fresh and not minty-sweet. The checked bottle is in the grid.

faqs.q: Bright Crystal Absolu or Dylan Blue Pour Femme?
faqs.a: Both are women's fruity florals with checked prices here. Absolu is yuzu, raspberry, peony, and amber. Dylan Blue Pour Femme is apple, peach, rose, and jasmine. The original Bright Crystal and men's Dylan Blue are not in the grid.

intro: Dolce & Gabbana fragrances are built as sunny, recognizable designer scents. Light Blue is the one most people mean: a fresh women's eau de toilette with apple, lemon, and cedar, light enough for daytime. The house also makes The One, a warmer amber, and a men's Light Blue that is a different bottle.
Shoppers who say Light Blue usually want the women's eau de toilette. Light Blue Eau Intense is a flanker, fuller than the original. The grid only prices a bottle after we have checked it.

known.name: Light Blue
known.text: The Dolce & Gabbana bottle with a checked price on this page. Women's eau de toilette: apple, Sicilian lemon, cedar, and white rose. A fresh daytime perfume.

known.name: Light Blue for Men
known.text: A fresh men's cologne in the same family, not the women's bottle. It is not priced on this page.

known.name: Light Blue Eau Intense
known.text: A flanker of Light Blue, fuller and less sheer than the original eau de toilette. A different bottle, and not the one in the grid unless the grid says so.

known.name: The One
known.text: The warmer Dolce & Gabbana, amber and floral rather than the citrus of Light Blue. It is a different gift, and this page does not price it.

choose: Light Blue is the gift for someone who wants a fresh, citrusy women's perfume they can wear in the daytime. It is a poor match for someone who asked for The One, or for the men's Light Blue.
Confirm women's Light Blue before you buy. The only Dolce & Gabbana price on this page is the bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue smell like?
faqs.a: A fresh women's eau de toilette: apple, Sicilian lemon, cedar, and white rose. It is a daytime perfume. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is Light Blue for men the same bottle?
faqs.a: No. Light Blue for men is a separate cologne. The bottle on this page is the women's eau de toilette.

faqs.q: Is Light Blue Eau Intense the same as Light Blue?
faqs.a: Eau Intense is a flanker, fuller than the original. The grid prices the original women's eau de toilette, not the intense flanker, unless the name in the grid says otherwise.

faqs.q: Who should skip Light Blue?
faqs.a: Someone who wants a sweet vanilla, a heavy evening perfume, or the men's cologne. Light Blue is for a person who likes fresh citrus.

intro: Davidoff is known first for Cool Water, the fresh men's cologne that has been a default gift for decades. It is aquatic and minty, built for daytime rather than a sweet night out. The house has other Cool Water flankers and a women's Cool Water, and they are not the same bottle.
If someone says Davidoff and does not name a flanker, they almost always mean the original men's Cool Water. The grid prices only the bottle we checked.

known.name: Cool Water
known.text: The Davidoff bottle with a checked price on this page. Men's eau de toilette: mint, sea water, sandalwood, and cedar. Fresh and aquatic.

known.name: Cool Water for Women
known.text: A separate perfume, fruity and floral, not the men's cologne. This page does not price it.

known.name: Cool Water Intense and other flankers
known.text: Later versions of the Cool Water idea, fuller or sweeter than the original. They are not the original men's bottle unless the grid name says so.

known.name: The Game
known.text: A different Davidoff cologne, not Cool Water. It is not priced here.

choose: Cool Water is the men's gift for someone who likes a fresh, aquatic cologne and does not want vanilla or a heavy evening scent. It is a familiar bottle, which is useful when you do not know their collection.
Skip it for someone who asked for a women's perfume or for a flanker by name. The only Davidoff price on this page is the Cool Water bottle in the grid.

faqs.q: What does Davidoff Cool Water smell like?
faqs.a: A fresh men's eau de toilette: mint, sea water, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a daytime cologne. The checked bottle is the one in the grid.

faqs.q: Is there a women's Cool Water?
faqs.a: Yes. Cool Water for women is a different perfume. The bottle on this page is the men's cologne.

faqs.q: Is Cool Water Intense the same bottle?
faqs.a: No. Intense and the other flankers are later versions. The grid prices the original men's Cool Water unless the name says otherwise.

faqs.q: Who should skip Cool Water?
faqs.a: Someone who wants a sweet gourmand or a heavy evening cologne. Cool Water is for a person who likes fresh and aquatic.
